scope: Study evidence and public computational paths; numerical reference files are authoritative.
status: Scientific analyses and scoped public reproduction checks independently verified.

results.title: Signed mean confidence–accuracy gap and mean-preserving construction
results.evidence_scope: Algebra and possibility example; no claim of empirical prevalence or latent-construct absence.

results.title: Core source: 6706 candidate models, 1168 ARC items; 6701 evaluated models from 1330 organizations
results.evidence_scope: Source quantities independently checked. Public raw arrays and all 50 feature tables reproduced exactly; the independent source audit checked 125 contexts and 55 reference sets without reading target labels.

results.title: All 31 primary and 31 secondary comparisons; 190 predictive effects
results.evidence_scope: The numerical results were independently checked. Between-easiness-bin confidence-bias variance meets the expanded-baseline criterion; easiness-weighted confident-error mass does not meet that criterion. All comparisons remain visible. Two bounded public final-fit checks reproduced held-out predictions exactly; these integration checks do not cover a complete nested search.

results.title: Descriptor availability and source repeatability
results.evidence_scope: Source summaries from the analysis; reference-population and cohort dependent.

results.title: Descriptive model selection
results.evidence_scope: Paired case-organization descriptive intervals; no binary decision-success threshold or measured deployment benefit.

results.title: Exploratory slope and five-summary/expanded-summary comparisons
results.evidence_scope: Analyses and their public runtime implementations independently verified. These are retrospective exploratory analyses with the documented task overlap.

results.title: Full-panel joint item-response supporting analysis: 6717 ARC, 6720 HellaSwag, 6716 shared models
results.evidence_scope: Full-panel supporting analysis. Full fits and statistics independently checked. Both public cold matrices reconstructed exactly; public bounded pilot/validation checks are separate from full fitting.

results.title: Standalone analysis figures and tables
results.evidence_scope: Standalone figure and table renderers consume the numerical reference results. The asset checker validates generated outputs and their inputs; scientific-result verification is documented separately.

results.title: Computational cost accounting
results.evidence_scope: Measured event totals and all 9,900 warm measurements were independently checked. Complete acquisition-to-results cold time remains unmeasured; the disk count is a total result-tree snapshot, not a new-byte delta.
